text: Called into today and was given an appointment for a few hours later. He did a great job cleaning my teeth, alot better job  than the hygienist in the UK what is 5X the price. Very happy. I would recommend. Thank you.

Had a perfect consultation as well as teeth cleaning and one filling. Was very gently but firm if needed to get the expected result. No extra fees or scams and Very fair prices and reliable know-how. For a quick check up and fillings, very recommended!

I, like other reviewers, have come back to Dr. Pichorn at PC Clinic many times over the years when in Bangkok. The doctor was educated in Buffalo, New York and he communicates well in English. This is handy since I do not speak Thai language. He does the teeth cleaning himself for a very reasonable price.
Honest and competent dentist. He did a walk in cleaning and exam, and didn’t try to add on any services such as claiming fake cavities which happens at so many dentists.
This dentist will give you a root, canal treatment "WITHOUT" using an anesthetic! Perfect, if you want to be tortured!
Anytime I come to BKK, Dr. Picharn is at the top of my list. Great dentist, great person to chat with and both his work and prices are perfection.
Good doctor, not painful at all - charged 1,500 for filling of 1 tooth. Quality work. Thank you!
Had dental treatment here before and recommend. Found this dentist through an expat and was very happy. Will be going again in the next few weeks
This dentist is a sadist. He gave me a root canal treatment without any anesthetic. The pain was so great I yelled at him to stop before running out.
Excellent service at a good price. Swift, effective care, doesn't try to give you what you don't need, and English-speaking - trained in the States. Highly recommend this place!
Despite being short on time and having a waiting list, the dentist saw me on the evening of December 30th to repair my broken temporary crown. Highly recommended!
A great doctor, specialist, and person who didn't refuse to help, even though I was in a rush! I recommend him to everyone. Excellent value for money and good quality.

Hey everyone. I had a toothache and went to this clinic. The man is a master of his craft and incredibly friendly on top of that. He had to extract a molar. Excellent work for only 1500 Baht. I'm almost ashamed that it cost so little. Highly recommended.
Received fantastic  treatment here many times over the years. Highly recommended.
I have visited PC dental a few times now and have found the work and the service to be brilliant.
